answer: Contact the release custodian, listed in the Duty Roster as Asha Venn. Before resuming Plover EU telemetry export, reconcile the export offsets and obtain incident lead approval; the roster lists Koen Li as the incident lead on rotation. The Plover page itself names no pre-resume steps and points to the Export Runbook for resumption. The US export path is owned by a different team (contact Ren Sol), which does not apply to EU suspension.
